title: VIBE: Vector Index Benchmark for Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2505.17810v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search is a performance-critical component of many machine learning pipelines, and rigorous benchmarking is essential for assessing the performance of vector indexes for ANN search. However, the datasets of existing benchmarks no longer represent modern ANN applications, creating a need for an up-to-date benchmark. To address this gap, we introduce Vector Index Benchmark for Embeddings (VIBE), an open-source framework for benchmarking ANN algorithms. VIBE provides a pipeline for generating benchmark datasets with dense embedding models representative of modern applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). To represent real-world workloads, we also include out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets where the queries and the corpus are drawn from different distributions. translated_title: VIBE：面向嵌入向量的向量索引基准测试
translated_abstract: 近似最近邻（ANN）搜索是许多机器学习流程中性能关键的部分，严格的基准测试对于评估向量索引在ANN搜索中的性能至关重要。然而，现有基准测试的数据集已不再代表现代ANN应用，因此需要更新的基准测试。为解决这一差距，我们引入了面向嵌入向量的向量索引基准测试（VIBE），这是一个用于基准测试ANN算法的开源框架。VIBE提供了一个流水线，用于生成代表现代应用（包括检索增强生成，RAG）的密集嵌入模型的数据集。为模拟真实工作负载，我们还包含了分布外（OOD）数据集，其中查询和语料库来自不同分布。这些包括多模态检索数据集和覆盖两个近期用例的最大内积搜索（MIPS）数据集。
tldr: 本文提出了VIBE，一个开源基准测试框架，通过生成代表现代应用（如RAG）的密集嵌入数据集和分布外多模态及MIPS数据集，填补了现有ANN基准测试数据集过时的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VIBE, an open-source benchmarking framework that addresses the outdated datasets in existing ANN benchmarks by generating dense embedding datasets representative of modern applications like RAG, along with out-of-distribution multimodal and MIPS datasets.
